Spells:
Clashing Rocks (O9 Conj): R1200' Creates two Colossal rocks that slam together in a ranged touch attack that inflicts 20d6 HP bludgeoning, knocked prone, and buried in rubble (save Reflex negates buried); a missed target and other creatures in the path of the rocks suffer 10d6 HP bludgeoning and knocked prone (save Reflex inflicts half HP only)
Magic Stone (O1 Tran): Enhances 3 touched stones (save Will negates) to attack at +1 and inflict 1d6+1 HP, or 2d6+2 HP vs. undead, within 30 min
Meld Into Stone (O3 Tran): Allows self to enter a block of stone for up to 200 min, which permits hearing, but not seeing, outside events and casting spells on self; Passwall cast on the stone ends the spell; Stone Shape inflicts 3d6 HP without ending the spell; significant damage to the stone, Stone To Flesh, or expiration of the duration ends the spell and inflicts 5d6 HP; destruction of the stone or Transmute Rock To Mud ends the spell and inflicts death (save Fortitude DC 18 inflicts 5d6 HP for destruction and no damage for Transmute Rock To Mud)
Repel Metal Or Stone (O8 Abju): 60' line pushes away unanchored metal and stone objects weighing up to 500 lb and bends or breaks fixed objects up to 3" in diameter for 20 rd
Statue (O7 Tran): Allows touched to transform into a statue with hardness 8 at will (save Will negates) for 20 hr
Stone Call (O2 Conj): R300' 40' radius inflicts 2d6 HP bludgeoning for 1 rd, then difficult terrain for 19 rd
Stone Tell (O6 Divi): Allows self to converse with stone for 20 min
Stoneskin (O5 Abju): Gives touched DR 10/adamantine (save Will negates) for 200 min or until 150 HP have been negated
Wall Of Stone (O5 Conj): R300' Creates a 100 square foot, 5"-thick permanent stone wall (the area can be doubled by halving the thickness); each 5' section has 75 hit points and hardness 8 (save Reflex avoids entrapment)
Magic Notes:
Charisma Oracle Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level O1, O2, O3
Spell Focus (Enchantment): +1 Spell DC (Enchantment)
Clobbering Strike: Can use a swift action after a critical hit with an attack spell to make a Trip attempt without provoking AOO
Elemental Spell (Cold): May use +1 spell slot to convert half or all spell damage to cold damage
Empower Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 2 levels higher than normal to increase its variable effects by 50%
Final Revelation (Stone Mystery): Can apply Enlarge Spell, Extend Spell, Silent Spell, or Still Spell when casting an acid or earth spell without increasing the level or casting time
Maximize Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 levels higher than normal to maximize all of its variable effects
Orisons: Knows 0-level spells
Persistent Spell: May spend +2 spell slot to force target to take worse of 2 saving throws
Quicken Spell: Once per rd, can cast a spell with a casting time of up to 1 rd as a free action, using a spell slot 4 levels higher than normal
Reach Spell: May cast touch, close, or medium range spell at longer range; uses +1 spell slot/range increase
Silent Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 1 level higher than normal to cast it without verbal components
